title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
short_summary: A bored girl named Alice follows a talking White Rabbit down a rabbit hole into a strange underground world called Wonderland. There she grows and shrinks after eating and drinking odd things, meets a grinning Cheshire Cat who can vanish at will, and joins a mad tea party hosted by the Hatter and the March Hare.
extended_summary:
A bored girl named Alice follows a talking White Rabbit down a rabbit hole into a strange underground world called Wonderland. There she grows and shrinks after eating and drinking odd things, meets a grinning Cheshire Cat who can vanish at will, and joins a mad tea party hosted by the Hatter and the March Hare.

Alice's journey eventually brings her before the fierce Queen of Hearts, who threatens to behead anyone who displeases her over the smallest things. During a chaotic trial in the Queen's court, the nonsense of Wonderland reaches its peak — until Alice suddenly wakes up back home, realizing the whole adventure was a dream.

questions.prompt: How does Alice first get to Wonderland?

options: She falls down a rabbit hole

questions.explanation: Alice follows the White Rabbit and falls down a long rabbit hole into Wonderland.

questions.prompt: A bottle labeled "Drink Me" makes Alice ___.
questions.explanation: Alice keeps changing size throughout the story by eating and drinking strange things.

questions.prompt: Match each character to what makes them memorable.

right: Hosts an endless, nonsensical tea party
Can disappear, leaving only his grin behind
Is always worried about being late

questions.explanation: Each character embodies a different kind of nonsense that makes Wonderland so strange.

questions.prompt: Sort each character into the right group.
questions.explanation: The Queen and her soldiers are dangerous, while the Rabbit and the Cat, odd as they are, point Alice in new directions.

questions.prompt: Why do you think Alice stays fairly calm even though Wonderland keeps changing the rules around her?
questions.explanation: There's no single right answer — Alice's curiosity and adaptability help her keep going even when nothing makes sense.

questions.prompt: In Wonderland, the Cheshire Cat can do something no ordinary cat can. What is it?

options: Disappear completely, except for his grin

questions.explanation: The Cheshire Cat has a habit of vanishing bit by bit, leaving just his wide grin floating in the air — which Alice finds almost as odd as the cat talking at all.

questions.prompt: At the mad tea party, it's always ___ o'clock, and nobody seems bothered by that.
questions.explanation: The Hatter's watch is stuck, so the tea party is frozen at teatime forever — perfectly logical, by Wonderland standards.

questions.prompt: Put Alice's tumble into Wonderland in order.

items: Alice, bored, notices a White Rabbit talking and checking a pocket watch
She follows him down a rabbit hole and falls for a very long time
She eats and drinks strange things that make her grow and shrink
She ends up before the fierce Queen of Hearts

questions.explanation: Each step gets a little stranger than the last — which is really just Wonderland's way of saying hello.

questions.prompt: Match each Wonderland rule to how backward it really is.

left: A cat can vanish, leaving only its smile
A queen can shout to behead someone over nothing
A watch can be permanently stuck at teatime
A drink can make you shrink instead of quench your thirst
right: Smiles don't usually exist without a face attached
Punishments don't usually fit such tiny 'crimes'
Drinks don't usually change your size

questions.explanation: Wonderland's whole trick is taking something almost-normal and bending just one rule of it until it's completely absurd.

questions.prompt: Sort each event into the right group.

content.groupA: Would happen in the real world

options.label: A rabbit worrying about being late
A cat's grin floating in the air on its own
A girl feeling curious about a strange noise
A cup of tea that never runs out because time is frozen

questions.explanation: Wonderland always starts from something ordinary, then twists it — that's exactly what makes it Wonderland.

questions.prompt: If you fell down your own rabbit hole into a world where one everyday rule stopped making sense — like time, or size, or gravity — which rule would you want it to be, and why?
questions.explanation: There's no single right answer — the fun of Wonderland is imagining which ordinary rule would be the most interesting to break.
